title: Sean Payton: Offensive focus needs to be on details, not who calls plays

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean Payton: Offensive focus needs to be on details, not who calls plays
sources.description: When the Broncos changed offensive playcallers this offseason, it guaranteed a lot of attention would be paid to how the unit fared with offensive coordinator Davis Webb calling the shots instead of head coach Sean Payton.
